{{Top|rwm|imp|italics=1}} {{ComicCollection |image=[[File:SWAgentOfTheEmpireV1.jpg]] |title=''Star Wars: Agent of the Empire
Volume 1—Iron Eclipse'' |writer=[[John Ostrander]] |penciller=*[[Stéphane Roux]] *[[Stéphane Créty]] |inker=[[Julien Hugonnard-Bert]] |letterer=[[Michael Heisler]] |colorist=[[Wes Dzioba]] |cover artist=Stéphane Roux |editor=[[Randy Stradley]] |publisher=[[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse Books]] |release date=[[October 24]], [[2012]]{{DarkHorse|url=Books/19-041/Star-Wars-Agent-of-the-Empire-Iron-Eclipse-TPB|text=Star Wars: Agent of the Empire—Iron Eclipse TPB}} |other date= |media type=Trade paperback |pages=120 |isbn=9781595829504 |isbn2= |timeline=[[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] |series=''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse]]'' |issues=1–5 |preceded by= |followed by=[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire Volume 2—Hard Targets|''Agent of the Empire Volume 2—Hard Targets'']] }} '''''Star Wars: Agent of the Empire Volume 1—Iron Eclipse''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] that collects the five-part comic-book series ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse]]'' from author [[John Ostrander]]. It was published by [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse Books]] on [[October 24]], [[2012]]. ==Publisher's summary== ''Imperial power is at its height. With Palpatine on the throne and his chief enforcer, Darth Vader, leading fleets of Star Destroyers and legions of stormtroopers across the galaxy, the Empire is an unstoppable power for order and peace. '' ''But not every political problem requires military might; not every negotiation depends on a show of force. Sometimes all diplomacy needs to succeed is the right man, in the right place, with the willingness to get the job done. No matter what it takes.'' ''Meet Jahan Cross, agent of the Empire...'' ==Contents== *[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]] *[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 2|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 2]] *[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 3|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 3]] *[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 4|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 4]] *[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 5|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 5]] ==Media== ===Editions=== *{{ISBN|9781595829504}}; [[October 24]], [[2012]]; [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse Books]]; US paperback ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{DarkHorse|url=Books/19-041/Star-Wars-Agent-of-the-Empire-Iron-Eclipse-TPB|text=Star Wars: Agent of the Empire—Iron Eclipse TPB}} {{Interlang |ka=ვარსკვლავური ომები: იმპერიის აგენტი, ტომი 1: რკინის დაბნელება |pl=Agent of the Empire: Iron Eclipse (wydanie zbiorcze) }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Agent of the Empire 1}} [[Category:Dark Horse Comics trade paperbacks]] [[Category:Legends trade paperbacks]]
